row.body: The mill tool sheet records a saw crew sent home before its truck was cleared; the last sharpening charge is still billed to the next shift.
row.title: Tools on the unpaid shift

sidecar.gloss: A work crew leaves before its truck is cleared, with costs carried forward.
sidecar.rival_reading: A field program could also hire mill workers and bill tools across shifts; the sheet does not say who ordered the crew home.
